user.title: Lidl Plus
user.description: Choose the country of your Lidl Plus account. Sign-in uses the Browser Companion add-on (Chromium in the sidebar).

language.title: Lidl Plus language
language.description: This country has more than one Lidl Plus language.

companion.title: Browser Companion
companion.description:
Open Browser Companion in a new window:

[{companion_url}]({companion_href})

Complete captcha, password and MFA there. This screen waits for the com.lidlplus.app:// redirect.

companion_failed.title: Browser Companion
companion_failed.description:
Could not sign in with Browser Companion. Start the add-on, then submit to try again.

[{companion_url}]({companion_href})

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Lidl Plus servers.
error.invalid_token: Token was rejected. Sign in again.
error.companion_unavailable: Browser Companion did not capture the login. Start the add-on and try again.

abort.already_configured: This loyalty card is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: This token belongs to a different loyalty card.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach Lidl Plus servers.
abort.invalid_token: The captured login was rejected. Try again.
abort.companion_requires_supervisor: Lidl Plus needs Home Assistant OS or Supervised with the Browser Companion add-on.
abort.companion_not_running: Start the Browser Companion add-on, then add this integration again.
